items.title: Awesome Agi Cocosci
items.content_text:
### Domain Specific Language / Declarative DSL Applications

*   [A prometastatic splicing program regulated by SNRPA1 interactions with structured RNA elements](https://www.science.org/doi/full/10.1126/science.abc7531) - ***Science***, 2021. \[[All Versions](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?cluster=9442501233912150085)]. Pathological changes in alternative splicing patterns are considered a hallmark of cancer, yet the underlying regulatory programs that control this process remain largely unknown. A major obstacle to better understanding these programs is that the bioinformatic strategies commonly used for the discovery of cis-regulatory elements fail to capture the contribution of RNA secondary structure to regulatory information. To address this, this work had previously developed the computational framework TEISER (Tool for Eliciting Informative Structural Elements in RNA), which uses both RNA structural and sequence information to identify cis-regulatory elements that are informative of transcriptomic changes. Here, the authors introduce pyTEISER (pythonic TEISER), which incorporates experimentally derived and additional computationally predicted RNA structural information to investigate the RNA sequence and structural code that governs a broader range of RNA-related processes, including splicing and RNA processing, in addition to steady-state gene expression.

### Copilot

*   [Cline](https://cline.bot/) - Open source AI coding for VSCode. See every decision and use your own models.
    *   [RooCode (⭐19k)](https://github.com/RooCodeInc/Roo-Code) - Cline fork with some improvements.

### Midjourney

*   [ComfyUI (⭐87k)](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI) - ComfyUI lets you execute advanced image generation pipelines using an advanced interface. Available on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
*   [Stable Diffusion Web UI (⭐156k)](https://github.com/AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui) - A browser interface for Stable Diffusion and other models.
*   [InvokeAI (⭐26k)](https://github.com/invoke-ai/InvokeAI) - Generate and create stunning visual media using the latest AI-driven technologies locally.

### Link Shorteners

*   [tnyr.me](https://tnyr.me) - A zero-trust URL shortener with paswordless end-to-end encryption.

### Pastebin and Secret Sharing

*   [dele-to](https://dele.to) - Open Source. Modern app to share sensitive credentials and secrets securely with client-side AES-256 encryption, zero-knowledge architecture, and automatic self-destruction.

### Text to Speech

*   [Kokoro FastAPI (⭐3.5k)](https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI) - Dockerized FastAPI wrapper for [Kokoro-82M](https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) text-to-speech model w/CPU, ONNX and NVIDIA GPU support, handling, and auto-stitching.
*   [MeloTTS (⭐6.7k)](https://github.com/myshell-ai/MeloTTS) - a high-quality multi-lingual text-to-speech library by MIT and MyShell.ai.

items.title: Awesome Nix
items.content_text:
### Resources / Learning

*   [Nix in 100 Seconds](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FJVFXsNzYZQ) - A YouTube video from Fireship presenting Nix in 100 seconds.
*   [Tour of Nix](https://nixcloud.io/tour/) - An online interactive tutorial on Nix language constructs.

### Resources / Discovery

*   [Searchix](https://searchix.ovh/) - Search Nix packages and options from NixOS, Darwin and Home Manager.

### Deployment Tools / Discovery

*   [terraform-nixos (⭐376)](https://github.com/nix-community/terraform-nixos) - A set of Terraform modules designed to deploy NixOS.

### Virtualisation / Discovery

*   [microvm (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/microvm-nix/microvm.nix) - NixOS-based MicroVMs.

### Command-Line Tools / Discovery

*   [angrr (⭐40)](https://github.com/linyinfeng/angrr) - Auto Nix GC Roots Retention. This tool simply deletes auto GC roots based on the modified time of their symbolic link target.
*   [nh (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/nix-community/nh) - Better output for `nix`, `nixos-rebuild`, `home-manager` and nix-darwin CLI leveraging `dix` and `nix-output-monitor`.
*   [nix-index (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/nix-community/nix-index) - Quickly locate Nix packages with specific files.
*   [statix (⭐708)](https://github.com/oppiliappan/statix) - A linter/fixer to check for and fix antipatterns in Nix code.

### Development / Discovery

*   [Cachix](https://www.cachix.org) - Hosted binary cache service; free for open-source projects.
*   [Devbox (⭐10k)](https://github.com/jetify-com/devbox) - Instant, portable, and predictable development environments.
*   [pre-commit-hooks.nix (⭐694)](https://github.com/cachix/git-hooks.nix) - Run linters/formatters at commit time and on your CI.
*   [robotnix (⭐700)](https://github.com/nix-community/robotnix) - A declarative and reproducible build system for Android (AOSP) images.

### DevOps / Discovery

*   [Nix GitLab CI](https://gitlab.com/TECHNOFAB/nix-gitlab-ci) - Define GitLab CI pipelines in pure Nix with full access to all Nix packages (incl. caching).

### Programming Languages / Ruby

*   [ruby-nix (⭐140)](https://github.com/inscapist/ruby-nix) - Generates reproducible ruby/bundler app environment with Nix.

### Programming Languages / Rust

*   [naersk (⭐869)](https://github.com/nix-community/naersk) - Build Rust packages directly from `Cargo.lock`. No conversion step needed.
*   [nix-cargo-integration (⭐203)](https://github.com/90-008/nix-cargo-integration) - A library that allows easy and effortless integration for Cargo projects.
*   [rust-nix-templater (⭐49)](https://github.com/90-008/rust-nix-templater) - Generates Nix build and development files for Rust projects.

### NixOS Modules / Zig

*   [nix-darwin (⭐4.4k)](https://github.com/nix-darwin/nix-darwin) - Manage macOS configuration just like on NixOS.
*   [NixOS hardware (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/NixOS/nixos-hardware) - NixOS profiles to optimize settings for different hardware.

### NixOS Configuration Editors / Desktop apps

*   [NixOS Configuration Editor (⭐573)](https://github.com/snowfallorg/nixos-conf-editor) - Graphical editor for NixOS configuration. Desktop app in Rust and GTK.
*   [Nix Software Center (⭐712)](https://github.com/snowfallorg/nix-software-center) - Install and manage Nix packages. Desktop app in Rust and GTK.
